```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)
library(kableExtra)
library(parallel)

library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(vars)     # VAR, causality, irf, fevd
library(lmtest)
library(urca)     # ca.jo

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 3.5)
options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(636)
```

## Parameters

```{r paths}
src <- "../../data"
dst <- "../../output"
for (d in c("figures", "tables")) dir.create(file.path(dst, d), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r parameters}

LANG      <- "de_en"   # main: de_en; SI: de, all
THR       <- "065"     # main: 065 (score >= 0.65); SI: 05 (score >= 0.5), q3 (third quartile)
EMOTIONS  <- c("fear", "anger")  # main; disgust only as robustness check (see below)
P_FIXED   <- NULL      # NULL = lag order selected by SC; or set a number
BOOT_RUNS <- 10000     # IRF and FEVD bootstrap runs (main analysis)
BOOT_ROB  <- 1000      # bootstrap runs in the robustness section
N_CORES   <- 4        # FEVD bootstrap

# output suffix, so that non-main runs do not overwrite the main tables and figures
main_spec <- LANG == "de_en" && THR == "065" && identical(EMOTIONS, c("fear", "anger"))
tag <- if (main_spec) "" else paste0("_", LANG, "_", THR, "_", paste(EMOTIONS, collapse = "-"))

# variable names and labels (Cholesky order: untrustworthy news first)
endo <- c("ts_score", paste0("ts_", EMOTIONS))
LAB  <- c(ts_score = "Untrustworthy news", ts_fear = "Fear",
          ts_anger = "Anger", ts_disgust = "Disgust")[endo]
lab  <- setNames(tolower(LAB), endo)

# structural breaks in the untrustworthy news series (NewsGuard; language-independent)
BREAK1 <- as.Date("2022-07-01")
BREAK2 <- as.Date("2022-08-28")
```

```{r custom plots}
custom_plot <- function() {
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}

# p-values for LaTeX: "$<$.001" or ".023" (no leading zero)
fmt_p_tex <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "$<$.001", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

save_tex <- function(x, name) {
  writeLines(as.character(x), file.path(dst, "tables", paste0(name, tag, ".tex")))
}
```

## Data

```{r data-functions}
# daily shares in %:
#   prop_news  = tweets with a news link / all tweets
#   prop_trust = tweets linking to untrustworthy news (NewsGuard < 60) / tweets with a news link
#   prop_<emo> = tweets with the emotion / classified tweets in the selected languages
# thr:   "065" (main), "05", or "q3"
# denom: "n_scored" (revision) or "tweet_count" (first submission)
# cutoff: NULL (as published) or a NewsGuard cutoff (requires N_<cutoff>, n_rated)
# smooth_k: trailing rolling mean over k days
prep_daily <- function(df, thr = THR, denom = "n_scored", emotions = EMOTIONS,
                       cutoff = NULL, smooth_k = 1) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(day = as.Date(day)) %>%
    arrange(day) %>%
    mutate(
      prop_news  = count_ng_domains / tweet_count * 100,
      prop_trust = (count_caution + count_max_caution) / count_ng_domains * 100
    )
  for (e in emotions) {
    df[[paste0("prop_", e)]] <- df[[paste0("count_", e, "_", thr)]] / df[[denom]] * 100
  }
  if (!is.null(cutoff)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(prop_trust = .data[[paste0("N_", cutoff)]] / n_rated * 100)
  }
  if (smooth_k > 1) {
    cols <- c("prop_news", "prop_trust", paste0("prop_", emotions))
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(cols),
                    ~ as.numeric(stats::filter(.x, rep(1 / smooth_k, smooth_k), sides = 1)))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(prop_trust))
  }
  df
}

read_daily <- function(lang) {
  read.csv(file.path(src, paste0("Austria-Panel-Daily-", lang, ".csv")))
}
```

```{r data}
daily_file <- file.path(src, paste0("Austria-Panel-Daily-", LANG, ".csv"))
daily_summary <- prep_daily(read_daily(LANG), thr = THR)
stopifnot(!anyNA(daily_summary[, c("prop_news", "prop_trust", paste0("prop_", EMOTIONS))]))

start_date <- min(daily_summary$day)
mk_ts <- function(x) ts(x, start = c(year(start_date), yday(start_date)), frequency = 7)

ts_news  <- mk_ts(daily_summary$prop_news)
ts_score <- mk_ts(daily_summary$prop_trust)
for (e in EMOTIONS) assign(paste0("ts_", e), mk_ts(daily_summary[[paste0("prop_", e)]]))

n     <- nrow(daily_summary)
step1 <- as.numeric(daily_summary$day >= BREAK1)
step2 <- as.numeric(daily_summary$day >= BREAK2)
exog  <- cbind(step1, step2, ts_news)

data_I1 <- do.call(cbind, mget(endo))   # endogenous variables, Cholesky order
colnames(data_I1) <- endo

cat(sprintf("%s, threshold %s: %d days (%s to %s); classified tweets: %s of %s\n",
            LANG, THR, n, min(daily_summary$day), max(daily_summary$day),
            format(sum(daily_summary$n_scored), big.mark = ","),
            format(sum(daily_summary$tweet_count), big.mark = ",")))
```

```{r descriptives}
# shares for the manuscript (Methods): overall and mean daily shares
overall <- sapply(EMOTIONS, function(e)
  sum(daily_summary[[paste0("count_", e, "_", THR)]]) / sum(daily_summary$n_scored) * 100)
round(overall, 2)

daily_summary %>%
  summarise(across(c(prop_news, prop_trust, all_of(paste0("prop_", EMOTIONS))),
                   list(mean = mean, sd = sd, min = min, max = max))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "prop_(.*)_(mean|sd|min|max)") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
```

### Stationarity tests

```{r unit-roots}
fmt_p <- function(p, lower = 0.01, upper = 0.99, tol = 1e-8) {
  if (p <= lower + tol) return("$\\leq$.01")
  if (p >= upper - tol) return(sprintf("$\\geq$%s", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", upper))))
  sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p))
}

variables <- c(list("News" = ts_news),
               setNames(lapply(endo, function(v) get(v)), LAB))

unit_root_table <- map_dfr(names(variables), function(var_name) {
  x <- variables[[var_name]]
  adf  <- adf.test(x)
  pp   <- pp.test(x)
  kpss <- kpss.test(x, null = "Level")
  tibble(
    Variable = var_name,
    ADF  = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", adf$statistic),  " (", fmt_p(adf$p.value), ")"),
    PP   = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", pp$statistic),   " (", fmt_p(pp$p.value), ")"),
    KPSS = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", kpss$statistic), " (", fmt_p(kpss$p.value, upper = 0.10), ")")
  )
})
unit_root_table

save_tex(kable(unit_root_table, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
               align = c("l", "c", "c", "c"), escape = FALSE),
         "unit_root_table")
```

### Lag order

The [forecast tutorial](https://otexts.com/fpp2/VAR.html): for VAR models, prefer
SC (BIC) over AIC, which tends to choose many lags. Lütkepohl (2005, Section 6.2):
if trends are captured by other means (e.g., dummies for structural breaks), the
constant-only specification is preferable.

```{r lag-selection}
sel <- VARselect(data_I1, lag.max = 14, type = "const", exogen = exog)
sel$selection
P <- if (is.null(P_FIXED)) sel$selection[["SC(n)"]] else P_FIXED
cat("Lag order used:", P, "\n")

# lag order of the differenced system (for the Johansen test)
VARselect(diff(data_I1), exogen = diff(exog))$selection
```

### Tests for co-integration

```{r johansen}
jo_results <- ca.jo(data_I1, type = "trace", ecdet = "const",
                    K = P, spec = "transitory",
                    dumvar = cbind(step1, step2))  # structural break dummies
summary(jo_results)

test_stats  <- jo_results@teststat
crit_values <- jo_results@cval

# urca orders rows from r <= K-1 down to r = 0; reverse to r = 0 first
h0  <- trimws(sub("\\|", "", rownames(crit_values)))
h0  <- sub("<=", "$\\\\leq$", h0)
ord <- rev(seq_along(test_stats))

jo_results_table <- data.frame(
  H0        = h0[ord],
  Statistic = round(test_stats[ord], 2),
  "10%"     = crit_values[ord, 1],
  "5%"      = crit_values[ord, 2],
  "1%"      = crit_values[ord, 3],
  check.names = FALSE
)
jo_results_table

save_tex(kable(jo_results_table, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
               align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
               col.names = c("$H_0$", "Statistic", "10\\%", "5\\%", "1\\%"),
               escape = FALSE),
         "jo_results_table")
```

If the rank equals the number of variables (r = K, full rank), the system is
stationary and a standard VAR in levels is appropriate (Lütkepohl, 2005).

### VAR in levels: diagnostics

```{r var-diagnostics}
summary_df <- map_dfr(sort(unique(pmax(1, c(P - 1, P, P + 1)))), function(p) {
  m <- VAR(data_I1, p = p, type = "const", exogen = exog)
  r <- roots(m)
  s <- serial.test(m, lags.pt = 16, type = "PT.asymptotic")$serial
  a <- arch.test(m, lags.multi = 12)$arch.mul
  j <- normality.test(m, multivariate.only = TRUE)$jb.mul$JB
  tibble(p = p, stable = all(r < 1), max_root = max(r),
         serial_chisq = unname(s$statistic), serial_df = unname(s$parameter), serial_p = s$p.value,
         arch_chisq = unname(a$statistic), arch_df = unname(a$parameter), arch_p = a$p.value,
         norm_stat = unname(j$statistic), norm_df = unname(j$parameter), norm_p = j$p.value,
         aic = AIC(m), bic = BIC(m))
})

fmt_test <- function(stat, df, p) sprintf("%.2f (%d; %s)", stat, as.integer(df), fmt_p_tex(p))

formatted_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  Lags        = summary_df$p,
  Stable      = ifelse(summary_df$stable, "Yes", "No"),
  Max_Root    = sprintf("%.3f", summary_df$max_root),
  Serial_Test = fmt_test(summary_df$serial_chisq, summary_df$serial_df, summary_df$serial_p),
  ARCH_Test   = fmt_test(summary_df$arch_chisq, summary_df$arch_df, summary_df$arch_p),
  Normality   = fmt_test(summary_df$norm_stat, summary_df$norm_df, summary_df$norm_p),
  AIC         = sprintf("%.2f", summary_df$aic),
  BIC         = sprintf("%.2f", summary_df$bic)
)
formatted_diagnostics

save_tex(kable(formatted_diagnostics, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
               col.names = c("Lags (p)", "Stable", "Max Root", "Portmanteau test",
                             "ARCH test", "Normality", "AIC", "BIC"),
               align = c("c", "c", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"), escape = FALSE),
         "diagnostics_table")
```

## Granger causality

```{r granger}
# wild bootstrap keeps each day's residual size (heteroskedasticity) and only flips its sign
granger_table <- map_dfr(endo, function(v) {
  plain <- causality(final_var_model, cause = v)$Granger
  wild  <- causality(final_var_model, cause = v, boot = TRUE, boot.runs = BOOT_RUNS)$Granger
  tibble(cause = v, F = unname(plain$statistic),
         df1 = unname(plain$parameter[1]), df2 = unname(plain$parameter[2]),
         p_plain = plain$p.value, p_wild = wild$p.value)
})
print(granger_table)

# pairwise Granger tests (cause -> one response), Wald tests on the VAR coefficients
pairwise_granger <- function(m, cause, response) {
  eq   <- m$varresult[[response]]
  b    <- coef(eq)
  idx  <- grep(paste0("^", cause, "\\.l[0-9]+$"), names(b))
  R    <- diag(length(b))[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  W    <- t(R %*% b) %*% solve(R %*% vcov(eq) %*% t(R)) %*% (R %*% b)
  Fval <- as.numeric(W) / length(idx)
  tibble(cause = cause, response = response, F = Fval,
         p = pf(Fval, length(idx), df.residual(eq), lower.tail = FALSE))
}
pairwise <- map_dfr(endo, function(cv) map_dfr(setdiff(endo, cv),
                                               ~ pairwise_granger(final_var_model, cv, .x)))
pairwise %>% mutate(F = round(F, 2), p = signif(p, 3))

granger_formatted <- data.frame(
  Hypothesis = sapply(endo, function(v)
    paste(LAB[[v]], "$\\rightarrow$", paste(lab[setdiff(endo, v)], collapse = ", "))),
  F_stat = sprintf("%.2f", granger_table$F),
  df     = sprintf("(%d, %d)", as.integer(granger_table$df1), as.integer(granger_table$df2)),
  p_wild = fmt_p_tex(granger_table$p_wild)
)

save_tex(kable(granger_formatted, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
               align = c("l", "r", "c", "r"),
               col.names = c("$H_0$: no Granger causality", "F", "df", "$p$ (bootstrap)"),
               escape = FALSE),
         "granger_table")
```

```{r irf}

irfs <- setNames(lapply(endo, function(v)
  irf(final_var_model, impulse = v, n.ahead = 30, ortho = FALSE,
      boot = TRUE, runs = BOOT_RUNS)), endo)
```

```{r shocks}
var_resid <- residuals(final_var_model)
resid_sd  <- apply(var_resid, 2, sd)
resid_max <- apply(var_resid, 2, max)
var_means <- colMeans(data_I1)

# day of the maximum shock (residuals start after the first P lags)
resid_days <- daily_summary$day[(P + 1):n]

shock_table <- data.frame(
  Shock = LAB,
  Day   = format(resid_days[apply(var_resid[, endo], 2, which.max)], "%d %b %Y"),
  Mean  = sprintf("%.1f\\%%", var_means[endo]),
  pp    = sprintf("+%.1f", resid_max[endo]),
  pct   = sprintf("+%.0f\\%%", 100 * resid_max[endo] / var_means[endo]),
  sd    = sprintf("%.1f", resid_max[endo] / resid_sd[endo])
)
shock_table

save_tex(kable(shock_table, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
               align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
               col.names = c("Shock", "Day", "Mean", "Shock (pp)",
                             "Shock (\\% of mean)", "Shock (SD)"),
               escape = FALSE),
         "shock_table")
```

```{r irf-data}
# responses to the maximum observed shock, in pp, SD, or % of the response's mean
extract_irf_data <- function(impulse, response, units = c("pp", "sd", "pct"), irf_list = irfs) {
  units <- match.arg(units)
  scale_r <- switch(units, pp = 1, sd = resid_sd[[response]],
                    pct = var_means[[response]] / 100)
  f <- resid_max[[impulse]] / scale_r
  io <- irf_list[[impulse]]
  # computed outside tibble(): inside it, the new column `response` would mask the argument
  est <- io$irf[[impulse]][, response] * f
  lo  <- io$Lower[[impulse]][, response] * f
  hi  <- io$Upper[[impulse]][, response] * f
  resp_name <- response
  tibble(days = seq_along(est) - 1, response = est, lower = lo, upper = hi,
         impulse_var = impulse, response_var = resp_name)
}

irf_units <- "pct"
irf_all <- map_dfr(endo, function(i) map_dfr(endo, ~ extract_irf_data(i, .x, irf_units)))

# peak cross-variable responses in pp, SD, and % of mean
peak_table <- map_dfr(endo, function(i) map_dfr(endo, ~ extract_irf_data(i, .x, "pp"))) %>%
  filter(impulse_var != response_var, days > 0) %>%
  group_by(impulse_var, response_var) %>%
  slice_max(abs(response), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    shock_in_sd       = unname(resid_max[impulse_var] / resid_sd[impulse_var]),
    shock_pct_of_mean = 100 * unname(resid_max[impulse_var] / var_means[impulse_var]),
    response_sd       = response / unname(resid_sd[response_var]),
    response_pct      = 100 * response / unname(var_means[response_var]),
    ci_pct            = sprintf("[%.1f, %.1f]",
                                100 * lower / unname(var_means[response_var]),
                                100 * upper / unname(var_means[response_var])),
    significant       = lower > 0 | upper < 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(impulse_var, response_var, days, shock_in_sd, shock_pct_of_mean,
                response_pp = response, response_sd, response_pct, ci_pct, significant)
print(peak_table, width = Inf)

# days with significant cross-variable responses
irf_all %>%
  filter(impulse_var != response_var, lower > 0 | upper < 0) %>%
  group_by(impulse_var, response_var) %>%
  summarise(days = paste(days, collapse = ","),
            min_pct = round(min(response), 1), max_pct = round(max(response), 1),
            .groups = "drop")
```

## Forecast error variance decomposition

```{r fevd-bootstrap, cache=TRUE, cache.extra=list(LANG, THR, EMOTIONS, P, BOOT_RUNS, tools::md5sum(daily_file))}
# residual bootstrap: resample residual rows (keeps the contemporaneous correlation),
# rebuild the series recursively with the estimated coefficients and the original
# exogenous variables, re-estimate the VAR, and compute the FEVD
determine_fevd <- function(var_model, y, exogen, lags,
                           horizons = c(1, 3, 7, 14, 30), boot_runs = 10000,
                           cores = 1) {
  endo_names <- colnames(y)
  exog_names <- colnames(exogen)
  K <- length(endo_names)
  n_obs <- nrow(y)
  max_horizon <- max(horizons)

  # coefficient matrix: rows = equations, columns = regressors (y1.l1, y2.l1, ..., const, exog)
  regressor_names <- c(paste0(rep(endo_names, times = lags), ".l", rep(1:lags, each = K)),
                       "const", exog_names)
  coef_mat <- t(sapply(endo_names, function(v) coef(var_model$varresult[[v]])[regressor_names]))

  resids   <- scale(residuals(var_model), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  y_mat    <- as.matrix(y)
  exog_mat <- as.matrix(exogen)
  fevd_point <- fevd(var_model, n.ahead = max_horizon)

  one_draw <- function(i) {
    u_star <- resids[sample.int(nrow(resids), replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    y_star <- y_mat
    for (t in (lags + 1):n_obs) {
      lagged <- as.vector(t(y_star[(t - 1):(t - lags), , drop = FALSE]))
      y_star[t, ] <- coef_mat %*% c(lagged, 1, exog_mat[t, ]) + u_star[t - lags, ]
    }
    colnames(y_star) <- endo_names
    var_star  <- VAR(y_star, p = lags, type = "const", exogen = exog_mat)
    fevd_star <- fevd(var_star, n.ahead = max_horizon)
    # array: horizon x shock x response
    sapply(endo_names, function(resp) fevd_star[[resp]][horizons, endo_names, drop = FALSE],
           simplify = "array")
  }

  RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG"); set.seed(636)
  boot_array <- simplify2array(mclapply(1:boot_runs, one_draw, mc.cores = cores))

  map_dfr(endo_names, function(resp) map_dfr(endo_names, function(shock) {
    draws <- matrix(boot_array[, shock, resp, , drop = TRUE], nrow = length(horizons))
    tibble(response = resp, shock = shock, horizon = horizons,
           fevd = fevd_point[[resp]][horizons, shock] * 100,
           boot_mean = rowMeans(draws) * 100,
           boot_sd = apply(draws, 1, sd) * 100,
           lower = apply(draws, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025) * 100,
           upper = apply(draws, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975) * 100)
  }))
}

fevd_boot <- determine_fevd(final_var_model, y = data_I1, exogen = exog, lags = P,
                            boot_runs = BOOT_RUNS, cores = N_CORES)
```

```{r fevd-table}
# in determine_fevd(), `shock` inside tibble() refers to the recycled column, so the point
# estimate is a matrix with identical columns; keep one (fixed here, not in the cached
# chunk, so that the bootstrap is not rerun)
if (is.matrix(fevd_boot$fevd)) {
  stopifnot(all(abs(fevd_boot$fevd - fevd_boot$fevd[, 1]) < 1e-10))
  fevd_boot$fevd <- fevd_boot$fevd[, 1]
}
```

## Robustness checks (SI)

Refits the main specification (VAR in levels, constant, structural break dummies and
news sharing as exogenous variables) for:

- `main`: German and English, score >= 0.65, fear and anger (lag order P)
- `with disgust`: as main, with disgust as a third emotion (response letter R3.8);
  disgust is ordered last, so it cannot change the contemporaneous ordering of the main variables
- `German only`, `all languages`: emotion scores of German tweets only / all tweets
- `third quartile`: emotion present if the score is above its third quartile
  (as in the first submission), denominator classified tweets
- `threshold 0.5`: emotion present if the score is >= 0.5
- `HQ lag order`: main specification with the lag order selected by HQ (more lags than SC),
  because the residuals at the SC lag order remain serially correlated
- `anger before fear`: main specification with anger ordered before fear; the IRFs are
  non-orthogonalized and do not change, but the FEVD depends on the ordering
- `first submission`: all languages, third quartile, denominator all tweets,
  fear and anger, p = 9; must reproduce the first-submission results
- `3-day rolling`: trailing 3-day means of all series; smoothing induces serial
  correlation, so the lag order is re-selected (SC)
- `cutoff < 50`: untrustworthy share with a NewsGuard cutoff of 50 instead of 60;
  `cutoff < 60 (rated)` is the reference with the same denominator (rated links)

Each variant is fitted at P and at its own SC lag order where they differ.
Bootstrap runs are lower than in the main analysis (`BOOT_ROB`).

```{r robustness-function}
fit_var_variant <- function(df, label, emotions = EMOTIONS, p = NULL, boot_runs = BOOT_ROB) {
  ev <- paste0("ts_", emotions)
  y  <- as.matrix(data.frame(ts_score = df$prop_trust,
                             setNames(df[paste0("prop_", emotions)], ev)))
  ex <- cbind(step1   = as.numeric(df$day >= BREAK1),
              step2   = as.numeric(df$day >= BREAK2),
              ts_news = df$prop_news)
  p_sc <- VARselect(y, lag.max = 14, type = "const", exogen = ex)$selection[["SC(n)"]]
  if (is.null(p)) p <- p_sc
  # p and ex are inlined into the stored call: irf(boot = TRUE) re-estimates the model with
  # update(), which evaluates the call outside this function, where p and ex do not exist
  m <- eval(bquote(VAR(y, p = .(p), type = "const", exogen = .(ex))))
  vars_m <- colnames(y)

  diag <- tibble(variant = label, p = p, p_sc = p_sc, n_days = nrow(df),
                 max_root = max(roots(m)),
                 serial_p = serial.test(m, lags.pt = 16, type = "PT.asymptotic")$serial$p.value)

  granger <- map_dfr(vars_m, function(v) {
    g <- causality(m, cause = v)$Granger
    tibble(cause = v, F = unname(g$statistic), p_value = g$p.value)
  }) %>% mutate(variant = label)

  # IRFs scaled as in the main analysis: maximum observed shock,
  # response in % of the response variable's mean
  shock <- apply(residuals(m), 2, max)
  means <- colMeans(y)
  pairs <- expand_grid(impulse = vars_m, response = vars_m) %>% filter(impulse != response)
  irf_tab <- pmap_dfr(pairs, function(impulse, response) {
    ir  <- irf(m, impulse = impulse, response = response, n.ahead = 30,
               ortho = FALSE, boot = TRUE, runs = boot_runs)
    f   <- shock[[impulse]] / (means[[response]] / 100)
    est <- ir$irf[[impulse]][, response] * f
    lo  <- ir$Lower[[impulse]][, response] * f
    hi  <- ir$Upper[[impulse]][, response] * f
    sig <- (lo > 0) | (hi < 0)
    tibble(variant = label, impulse = impulse, response = response,
           day2_pct = est[3], day2_ci = sprintf("[%.1f, %.1f]", lo[3], hi[3]),  # rows start at day 0
           peak_pct = est[which.max(abs(est))], peak_day = which.max(abs(est)) - 1,
           sig_days = paste(which(sig) - 1, collapse = ","))
  })

  fe <- fevd(m, n.ahead = 30)
  fevd_tab <- map_dfr(vars_m, function(r) tibble(
    variant = label, response = r, shock = vars_m, fevd30 = fe[[r]][30, vars_m]))

  list(model = m, diag = diag, granger = granger, irf = irf_tab, fevd = fevd_tab)
}
```

```{r robustness-fit, cache=TRUE, cache.extra=list(EMOTIONS, P, BOOT_ROB, tools::md5sum(file.path(src, paste0("Austria-Panel-Daily-", c("de_en", "de", "all"), ".csv"))))}
thr_file <- read.csv(file.path(src, "Austria-Panel-Daily-Thresholds.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(day, n_rated, N_50, N_60)
d_de_en <- read_daily("de_en")
d_de    <- read_daily("de")
d_all   <- read_daily("all")
d_cut   <- left_join(d_de_en, thr_file, by = "day")
emo_fad <- c(EMOTIONS, "disgust")
P_HQ    <- as.integer(sel$selection[["HQ(n)"]])   # lag order by HQ (chunk lag-selection)

variants <- list(
  list("main",                prep_daily(d_de_en),                     EMOTIONS, P),
  list("with disgust",        prep_daily(d_de_en, emotions = emo_fad), emo_fad,  P),
  list("with disgust (SC)",   prep_daily(d_de_en, emotions = emo_fad), emo_fad,  NULL),
  list("German only",         prep_daily(d_de),                        EMOTIONS, P),
  list("German only (SC)",    prep_daily(d_de),                        EMOTIONS, NULL),
  list("all languages",       prep_daily(d_all),                       EMOTIONS, P),
  list("all languages (SC)",  prep_daily(d_all),                       EMOTIONS, NULL),
  list("third quartile",      prep_daily(d_de_en, thr = "q3"),         EMOTIONS, P),
  list("third quartile (SC)", prep_daily(d_de_en, thr = "q3"),         EMOTIONS, NULL),
  list("threshold 0.5",       prep_daily(d_de_en, thr = "05"),         EMOTIONS, P),
  list("threshold 0.5 (SC)",  prep_daily(d_de_en, thr = "05"),         EMOTIONS, NULL),
  list(paste0("HQ lag order (p = ", P_HQ, ")"), prep_daily(d_de_en),   EMOTIONS, P_HQ),
  list("anger before fear",   prep_daily(d_de_en),                     rev(EMOTIONS), P),
  list("first submission (p = 9)",
       prep_daily(d_all, thr = "q3", denom = "tweet_count", emotions = c("fear", "anger")),
       c("fear", "anger"), 9),
  list("3-day rolling (SC)",  prep_daily(d_de_en, smooth_k = 3),       EMOTIONS, NULL),
  list("cutoff < 60 (rated)", prep_daily(d_cut, cutoff = 60),          EMOTIONS, P),
  list("cutoff < 50",         prep_daily(d_cut, cutoff = 50),          EMOTIONS, P)
)

rob <- setNames(lapply(variants, function(v)
  fit_var_variant(v[[2]], v[[1]], emotions = v[[3]], p = v[[4]])),
  sapply(variants, `[[`, 1))
```

```{r robustness-results}
# "main" must match the main analysis above; "first submission" must reproduce
# the first-submission results (Granger, IRF anger -> untrustworthy, FEVD)
bind_rows(map(rob, "diag"))
bind_rows(map(rob, "granger")) %>%
  mutate(p_value = signif(p_value, 3)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = variant, names_from = cause, values_from = c(F, p_value))
bind_rows(map(rob, "irf")) %>% arrange(impulse, response, variant) %>% print(n = Inf)
bind_rows(map(rob, "fevd")) %>% filter(response != shock) %>%
  mutate(fevd30 = round(100 * fevd30, 1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = variant, names_from = c(response, shock), values_from = fevd30,
              names_sep = "<-")

# agreement of the emotion series across language sets and thresholds (levels and daily changes)
emo_cmp <- map_dfr(EMOTIONS, function(e) {
  x <- tibble(de_en = prep_daily(d_de_en)[[paste0("prop_", e)]],
              de    = prep_daily(d_de)[[paste0("prop_", e)]],
              all   = prep_daily(d_all)[[paste0("prop_", e)]],
              q3    = prep_daily(d_de_en, thr = "q3")[[paste0("prop_", e)]],
              t05   = prep_daily(d_de_en, thr = "05")[[paste0("prop_", e)]])
  tibble(emotion = e,
         r_de = cor(x$de_en, x$de), r_all = cor(x$de_en, x$all), r_q3 = cor(x$de_en, x$q3),
         r_de_diff = cor(diff(x$de_en), diff(x$de)), r_all_diff = cor(diff(x$de_en), diff(x$all)),
         r_q3_diff = cor(diff(x$de_en), diff(x$q3)),
         r_05 = cor(x$de_en, x$t05), r_05_diff = cor(diff(x$de_en), diff(x$t05)))
})
emo_cmp %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
```

```{r robustness-disgust}
# Disgust as robustness check (response letter R3.8):
# (1) does disgust Granger-cause untrustworthy news or explain its variance?
# (2) does adding disgust change the anger and fear results of the main model?
wd <- rob[["with disgust"]]
wd$granger %>% filter(cause == "ts_disgust")
wd$irf %>% filter(impulse == "ts_disgust" | response == "ts_disgust")
wd$fevd %>% filter(shock == "ts_disgust" | response == "ts_disgust", response != shock) %>%
  mutate(fevd30 = round(100 * fevd30, 1))
# main vs. with disgust: IRFs and FEVD among untrustworthy news, fear, and anger
main_vars <- paste0("ts_", c("score", EMOTIONS))
bind_rows(rob[["main"]]$irf, wd$irf) %>%
  filter(impulse %in% main_vars, response %in% main_vars) %>%
  dplyr::select(variant, impulse, response, day2_pct, day2_ci, peak_pct, peak_day) %>%
  arrange(impulse, response, variant) %>% print(n = Inf)
bind_rows(rob[["main"]]$fevd, wd$fevd) %>%
  filter(response %in% main_vars, shock %in% main_vars, response != shock) %>%
  mutate(fevd30 = round(100 * fevd30, 1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(response, shock), names_from = variant, values_from = fevd30)
```

```{r robustness-table}
# compact SI table: key cross-variable results per variant
key_irf <- bind_rows(map(rob, "irf")) %>%
  filter(response == "ts_score", impulse == "ts_anger") %>%
  dplyr::select(variant, anger_to_untrust_day2 = day2_pct, ci = day2_ci)
key_fevd <- bind_rows(map(rob, "fevd")) %>%
  filter(response == "ts_score", shock != "ts_score") %>%
  mutate(shock = sub("ts_", "", shock), fevd30 = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * fevd30)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = variant, names_from = shock, values_from = fevd30,
              names_prefix = "fevd_untrust_", values_fill = "—")
rob_table <- key_irf %>%
  left_join(key_fevd, by = "variant") %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(map(rob, "diag")) %>% dplyr::select(variant, p, max_root, serial_p),
            by = "variant") %>%
  mutate(anger_to_untrust_day2 = sprintf("%.1f%%", anger_to_untrust_day2),
         max_root = sprintf("%.3f", max_root),
         serial_p = fmt_p_tex(serial_p))
rob_table

fevd_cols <- grep("^fevd_untrust_", names(rob_table), value = TRUE)
# escape % for LaTeX (an unescaped % starts a comment)
rob_table_tex <- rob_table %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ gsub("%", "\\%", .x, fixed = TRUE)))
save_tex(kable(rob_table_tex, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
               col.names = c("Variant", "Anger $\\rightarrow$ untrustworthy (day 2)", "95\\% CI",
                             paste("FEVD untrustworthy:", sub("fevd_untrust_", "", fevd_cols)),
                             "Lags", "Max. root", "Serial corr. $p$"),
               escape = FALSE),
         "var_robustness_table")
```
